import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
a = df[df.account_id=='JUNpaMa']

fam = a.pivot_table(index='date', columns='instance_family', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
fams = fam.columns
# weekday-of-month pattern for all other families: does cost repeat by (dayofweek, week-of-month)?
def wm(d): return (d.day-1)//7
idx = pd.DataFrame({'dow': fam.index.day_of_week, 'wm': [wm(d) for d in fam.index]}, index=fam.index)
others = [f for f in fams if f not in ['fG8wYOz6XO','g9c1yzr6KG']]
S = fam[others].sum(axis=1)
# build expected from same dow+wm of other weeks
pred=[]
for d in fam.index:
    key=(idx.loc[d,'dow'], idx.loc[d,'wm'])
    mask=(idx.dow==key[0])&(idx.wm==key[1])
    vals=S[mask & (mask.index!=d)]
    pred.append(vals.mean() if len(vals) else np.nan)
pred=pd.Series(pred,index=fam.index)
resid=(S-pred)/pred
print("other-families residual stats:", resid.describe().round(3))
anom_resid = resid[pd.Timestamp('2025-10-16')]
print("10-16 residual (others):", round(anom_resid,3), " 10-15:", round(resid[pd.Timestamp('2025-10-15')],3), "10-17:", round(resid[pd.Timestamp('2025-10-17')],3))

# Now the two suspect families vs their own dow+wm prediction
for f in ['fG8wYOz6XO','g9c1yzr6KG']:
    s=fam[f]
    p=[]
    for d in fam.index:
        key=(idx.loc[d,'dow'], idx.loc[d,'wm'])
        mask=(idx.dow==key[0])&(idx.wm==key[1]) & (mask.index!=d)
        vals=s[mask]; p.append(vals.mean() if len(vals) else np.nan)
    p=pd.Series(p,index=fam.index)
    r=(s-p)
    print("\n",f)
    print(pd.DataFrame({'actual':s.round(0),'pred':p.round(0),'delta':r.round(0)}).loc['2025-10-06':'2025-10-18'])
